2014_spells.word-of-radiance.description: You utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage.
2014_spells.word-of-radiance.effectSumma: Deal 1d6 radiant damage to a target within 5 ft
2014_spells.word-of-radiance.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, you utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or take 1d6 radiant damage; The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6). The effect happens immediately and then ends.
